runs.note: main-installed-details has no artboard of its own: it was judged against main-installed-single's 932 artboard and spec. The artboard is the one before UX-P2.8a-b's correction. Follow-up 4 corrected the main ruling on DS-COPY-1: the labels are Title Case and P3.11 owns them.

singleJudge.finding: [native] The list pane paints #181818 (side-bar surface, as the colour-role table says for the list pane) while the artboard paints it #1f1f1f like the details pane, so the artboard and the rules disagree on this region's surface.

[geometry] The row with the Vulnerable badge breaks the text rhythm of its neighbours: its name sits 1 px higher and its second line 1 px lower (ink at offsets 20 and 42 in the row, against 21 and 41 in the other rows), because the badge makes line 1 taller than the 20 px box of DS-ROW-1.
[native] Dependency framework rows showing '(0)' still draw an expand chevron, while a native tree row with no children draws no twisty, so an empty node reads as expandable.
[native] The Uninstall and Update buttons stack with a 6 px gap (y 116-142 and 148-174), where the spec has 4 px (uninstall-button bottom 156.2 to install-update-button top 160.2).

[geometry] The Details tab body starts about 8 px under the strip line (line at y 217, description ink at y 229, line box about y 225), against the 20 px details inset that DS-INSET-1 and the spec's readme-content padding (--nuiget-inset-details) give; the artboard's body has its first ink about 24 px under the line.
[states] The advisory text "High severity" is painted in the warning colour, though the colour-role table gives that colour to the severity glyph only and text takes the foreground role.

[states] The artboard draws the list pane on the editor surface (31/31/31), while the colour-role table assigns the list pane to the side-bar surface, which the capture paints (24/24/24); the capture follows the rule and the reference documents disagree.

refuted.finding: A 1 px focusBorder ring is drawn around the Installed tab (x 6-144, y 77-111), where the artboard shows only the 1 px underline on that tab and places focus on the selected row, so focus reads as sitting on the wrong element.
refuted.reason: The ring is visible, but the hard line 'DS-FOCUS-1@main-installed-single/tabs: tab [installed-tab]: outline 1 solid rgb(0, 120, 212) offset -1 (target 1 solid #0078d4 offset -1)' measures it as correct on this state's focused tab, and DS-FOCUS-3 requires a ring after a click in the main panel; the missing row focus is covered by D1.

refuted.finding: The Installed tab carries a 1 px focusBorder rectangle around its whole box (x 6-144, y 77-111), an element the artboard's installed-tab does not draw: the artboard shows only the active underline, with no ring at rest.
refuted.reason: The rectangle at x 6-144, y 77-111 is the measured focus ring, 'outline 1 solid rgb(0, 120, 212) offset -1 (target 1 solid #0078d4 offset -1) (hard)' on a state the suite lists in FOCUSED_TAB_STATES, so it is the required form on the focused tab rather than an extra element.

refuted.finding: Keyboard focus is drawn as a 1 px focusBorder ring around the Installed tab, which also hides its active underline, whereas the artboard draws that tab with the underline only and places the focus outline on the selected row.
refuted.reason: The ring is the measured 'outline 1 solid rgb(0, 120, 212) offset -1 (target 1 solid #0078d4 offset -1) (hard)', and the hidden-underline claim is contradicted by the hard 'DS-COLOR-4 ... line 1 panelTitle.activeBorder', the ring and underline merging as one #0078d4 colour at y 111.

refuted.finding: The Newtonsoft.Json author is truncated to "James Newton-Ki..." where the artboard, at the same 327 px list pane, shows "James Newton-King" whole; the spec declares no truncation of this text.
refuted.reason: 'James Newton-Ki...' is visible but is live author text under rubric §6 with the layout holding (PF-3a at 1200 reads 'Dapper 260 > 237, ellipsized' as accepted behaviour, and DS-TYPE-6 reads authors 600 ×14); the artboard's fixture has no scrollbar and does not show this row at this position, so it gives no 1:1 comparison.

refuted.finding: Newtonsoft.Json is drawn with a saturated orange cube, as are the other rows without a package icon, where the artboard draws that package as a muted monochrome package glyph on a neutral tile, so the fallback icon adds a decorative colour the approved composition lacks.
refuted.reason: The orange cube lies in the region the capture sidecar masks as live per-run icons, rect {x:46, y:625, w:36, h:36} on .nuiget-row-icon, equal to the finding's box, and the artboard crop at that box is blank, so it holds no glyph to compare.

refuted.finding: The framework rows under Dependencies use the same 13/600 semibold as the 'Dependencies' group header, so nine bold rows have no parent-child hierarchy, unlike regular-weight tree rows under a workbench header.
refuted.reason: The rule itself asks for this weight: hard DS-TYPE-5 reads 'level ×9: 13px/600/none ×9 (target 13px/600/none)', and these framework rows are measured as the details level headers.

refuted.finding: The same vulnerability is drawn in two colour roles: the details line 'High severity' uses an amber warning glyph and text, while the row's 'Vulnerable' badge and the tab's count badge use the error-red tone.
refuted.reason: The crop shows an amber glyph and text and the row badge is red, but no rule or colour-role row maps High severity to the error tone, so differing glyph and badge tones contradict nothing; the text colour alone stands as states-8.

refuted.finding: The end edges of the bulk toolbar and the group header no longer coincide: Uninstall selected ends at x 403 and the Direct Packages count badge at x 395, 8 px apart because of the 8 px layout scrollbar (x 412-419), while the artboard ends both at x 310.
refuted.reason: Both edges meet their rule: hard DS-INSET-3/headers reads 'group headers 16 (target 16)' with the badge at 369.3–396 in a box ending 412, the 8 px difference is the visible scrollbar in the crop, and no rule requires the two edges to coincide while a scrollbar shows.

refuted.finding: Children under the two details group headers use different indents: the Vulnerabilities row has its glyph at x 457 and text at x 476, while the Dependencies rows have the chevron at x 450 (16 px box from about 445) and text at x 464, so sibling groups show two child text columns 12 px apart. No rule or artboard element states the indent.
refuted.reason: The crop shows the two child indents, but the finding itself says no rule or artboard element states the indent, so rubric §6 excludes it.

findings.finding: [geometry] In the sixth row the long version squeezes the author text down to the Verified mark and a bare ellipsis, ending at x 274 although the line's room runs to about x 282 (the extent of the rows below), so the publisher the artboard's second line shows is not readable. | [states] Line 2 of the sixth row collapses the author to a bare "..." after the Verified mark, because the long preview version takes the room, so the author name DS-ROW-1 requires on that line is lost; the artboard shows the author on every row and the spec declares no such truncation.
findings.ruling: The facts line's hierarchy is DS-ROW-5's: the name truncates last, the version stays whole (half of the row's accessible name), the authors ellipsize after the Verified mark with the full text in the description (DS-TYPE-6, DS-ICON-4).
